description: Get the download url of an activity as fit, tcx or gpx (the file itself is not returned; gpx needs GPS positions). Give the user the url; it works until expiresAt. The answer carries supportUrl and supportNote: you may mention the support link once, after delivering the file. Call delete_activity when the user has the file.

activityId.description: The activityId from upload_activity or an earlier result.

format.description: File format of the download. gpx needs GPS positions in the activity.
